review_type: Independent, bounded static review of the current frontend integration diff
scope: modified frontend components and regression tests

logic_errors.title: Compaction updates the React projection but leaves the authoritative live-session snapshot un-compacted
logic_errors.trigger: Compact a session with at least three messages, then change its model configuration. compactSession assigns normalized to dataRef/setData without updating the existing LiveSession.data. The next mutateData reads that older LiveSession.data and publishes it again.
logic_errors.impact: A successful compaction is silently undone in memory and overwritten on disk when the user changes the model/run configuration, selects a Council winner, or performs another mutation based on current.messages. A direct follow-up send currently copies messages from dataRef and can preserve the compacted messages, but that special case does not repair the stale authoritative snapshot for the other mutation paths.
evidence: sendMessage constructs requestMessages at 813, then mutates at 815-825
logic_errors.fix: Commit successful compaction to the captured origin LiveSession through mutateData/publishLive under the existing navigation guard. Remove direct dataRef/setData writes for session-data mutations, or synchronize both representations atomically.
logic_errors.regression_test: Return a distinct summarized history from compact_session; then updateRunConfig and sendMessage. Assert the summarized history remains in the live snapshot, displayed messages, subsequent save_session, and outgoing request.
logic_errors.new_or_worsened: New integration regression: before the patch dataRef was authoritative; the newly introduced LiveSession map makes the unchanged direct compaction assignment stale.

logic_errors.title: Returning to a just-completed offscreen run can replace its complete memory snapshot with stale disk data
logic_errors.trigger: A run finishes offscreen and done sets live.runId=null before its queued final persistence completes (651-654). If another save is blocking the global persistence queue, return to A from a fresh empty session: switchSession skips the previous-session save and immediately calls load_session because A no longer has a runId. The load reads A's pre-completion disk snapshot while the final save is still queued. Line 1030 rejects the complete current snapshot solely because current.runId is null, then replaces the map entry with restored stale data.
logic_errors.impact: The final reply/artifacts/provider transcript disappear from the viewed session, and an originally successful run can appear cancelled. Subsequent navigation or sending persists that stale projection after the already-queued complete snapshot, permanently overwriting the final result.
evidence: done clears the live run identity before fire-and-forget persistData at 651-654
persistData serializes saves at 239-249, but switchSession does not await the pending tail when previous.messages is empty
switchSession trusts memory only while runId is non-null at 1027 and 1030
the new offscreen test waits for the final store status before navigating back, so it does not cover this boundary
logic_errors.fix: Prefer an existing authoritative LiveSession even after its run completes, or track revision/dirty/persisted generation and reject a disk snapshot older than the memory snapshot. Do not replace completed live state solely because runId became null.
logic_errors.regression_test: Block an unrelated save, finish A offscreen, navigate from an empty session to A before releasing the queue, then release saves and navigate away. Assert A's completed output/status/providerMessages survive in both memory and final disk state.
logic_errors.new_or_worsened: New failure path introduced by offscreen lifecycle support and the active-run-only cache check.

suggestions.title: Artifact selection bypasses LiveSession and is reset by the next publication
suggestions.trigger: Select an existing artifact through the exposed raw setActiveArtifactId, then receive any event or perform any mutateData operation. publishLive restores live.artifactId, which was never updated by that selection. Loaded sessions also initialize artifactId=null rather than selecting their first artifact as the previous switchSession did.
suggestions.fix: Expose a callback that writes viewedLive().artifactId and publishes it; initialize the desired artifact selection when restoring a session.
suggestions.regression_test: Select an older artifact, publish an unrelated chunk/model update, and assert the selected artifact remains active.

suggestions.title: Stopping during initial persistence never signals the queue's pause latch
suggestions.trigger: Hold the first save_session so the run remains starting; queue a follow-up in ChatCanvas; press Stop. stopAgent clears runId and restores live.stopRequested=false before publishing. ChatCanvas observes idle plus stopRequested=false, never latches stoppedWithQueue, and automatically dispatches the queued follow-up instead of waiting for Resume Queue.
suggestions.fix: Expose an explicit cancelled/stopped transition or persistent queue-pause intent even when cancellation occurs before native start. Do not rely on observing a transient stopRequested=true that is never published.
suggestions.regression_test: Exercise the real hook and canvas together with deferred initial persistence and an existing queue; Stop must prevent both the original launch and queue dispatch until explicit Resume.

verification.method: Source/diff tracing with exact current source reads; no tests, builds, IPC actions, commits, or source edits were run as required by the delegated scope.
verification.limits: Concurrent workers were modifying files during review. Findings were checked against reread source locations before writing this report. ui-fixes.md and hook-fixes.md were not present in the audit directory at discovery; parent-fixes.md and the original layer-state-review.md were consulted, and pre-existing unchanged issues were excluded.
positive_checks: Event routing and completion persistence target the origin LiveSession rather than the viewed dataRef
New/Switch no longer unconditionally abort offscreen runs
Late start failures are guarded by origin run identity
Queued ordinary prompts capture their execution mode/Council options and session identity
App shortcut changes respect modal/defaultPrevented state

summary: Fail: two concrete high-severity integration regressions remain in authoritative session state and offscreen completion restoration; two medium issues affect artifact selection and pre-start Stop queue behavior.
